entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes and a set of tires I recently purchased.
Okay, I can help you with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
Thanks! I see the order here. Before we proceed with the return, I need to ask: were the shoes or tires ever mounted or installed on your bike?
Uh, yeah, I did mount the tires and installed the cleats on the shoes to try them out on a ride.

I understand. Unfortunately, because the items have been mounted and used, we're unable to accept them for a return. With items that have been installed, like the tires, or had cleats installed on the shoes, we are unable to resell them as new. We would be able to accept a return for items that haven't been mounted or used, according to our policy.
Oh, I see. I didn't realize that. So, even though the shoes are only showing some light cleat marks, you can't take them back?

That's correct. Even with minimal cleat marks, or in the case of the tires with dirty tires from being ridden, they are considered used. We can't guarantee the same level of performance and lifespan as a brand-new product. This prevents us from being able to resell it as a new item.
Okay, I understand. So, there's nothing you can do?
Unfortunately, that's right in this case. Our return policy specifies that mounted and used items are not eligible for return. However, I can offer you a discount code for your next purchase with us.
Sure thing! I've applied a 15% discount code, WELCOMEBACK15, to your account, which you can use on your next order. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's all. Thanks so much for your help!
You're welcome! Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
